description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired, STAGED). Generalized CLASS of the P-vultisig M-02 miss: a position-management function withdraws user liquidity via a Uniswap-V3-style pool.burn()/decreaseLiquidity() and returns/forwards the resulting amount0/amount1 to a user WITHOUT any amountMin/slippage bound, so the burn can be MEV-sandwiched (user receives less than fair value). Two-signal: S1 a burn/decrease-liquidity primitive; S2 NO slippage floor (no amount0Min/amount1Min param, no 'slippage' marker, no min-amount comparison) in the function or a +1-level helper. Suppress: views; functions that DO take/check amountMin; library contracts; the mint/addLiquidity path. Anchor: vultisig ILOPool.claim (pool.burn(TICK_LOWER,TICK_UPPER,liquidity2Claim) -> amounts to user, no amountMin). Does NOT detect fee miscalc or oracle issues.

fp_controls.two_signal_required: S1 a burn/decrease-liquidity primitive AND S2 no amountMin/slippage floor in the function or a +1 helper.
fp_controls.slippage_suppression: an amount0Min/amount1Min param or a 'slippage'/minamount marker / min-amount comparison -> suppressed (the mint/addLiquidity path).
